content.short: Solhint-Prettier Plugin integrates Prettier formatting rules with the Solhint linter for Solidity.
content.description: Solhint-Prettier Plugin links Prettier’s formatting rules with the Solhint linter to bring cohesive style guidance to Solidity projects. As a Solidity linter, Solhint checks for a broad set of validation and security rules in accord with Solidity’s style conventions. Prettier, a widely adopted formatter, offers both standard presets and customizable formatting options. Using Solhint together with Prettier provides a consistent workflow for contract formatting and linting, helping teams maintain clean, readable Solidity code.

resources.title: Formatting As A Lint Rule
resources.tldr: Reports prettier differences as solhint problems, so style issues show up in the same output as everything else.

resources.title: Linting and Formatting Are Not the Same Job
resources.tldr: One catches bugs, the other catches disagreements. Why a Solidity project usually wants both, set up together.
